title: feat(platform-objects): Setup drops its unfiltered Packages entry; the full list lives in Studio
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8MFX42FUfma4vepCroC88iy)_
Fixes #25098

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：系统设置（Setup）的「应用」组去掉未过滤的「软件包」入口；完整软件包列表只留在 Studio → 总览 → 软件包。
- 为什么改：维护者裁决「二、软件包列表挪到 Studio ；甲」：完整列表是开发面，Setup 只保留应用市场过滤后的「已安装应用」入口。
- 风险与回滚：只删一个导航项及其四语种标签；页面本身没动，书签照常可开。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`setup-nav.contributions.ts`（删掉的那一行）、新 pin `setup-packages-door.test.ts`、changeset。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/apps/setup-packages-door.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`: Setup's `group_apps` contribution drops `nav_packages` (`developer:packages`, unfiltered). The group comment now says where the full list lives (Studio) and which Setup door remains: `nav_marketplace_installed`, the marketplace-filtered "Installed Apps" entry that `@objectstack/cloud-connection` contributes wherever the marketplace capability is present. Studio's `nav_packages` (`studio.app.ts`, Overview → Packages) is untouched.
- Translations: `apps.setup.navigation.nav_packages` is removed from `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES`, and its recorded digest from the three `*.source-hashes.ts` tables. `apps.studio.navigation.nav_packages` stays in all four catalogs and all three hash tables.
- `setup-packaged-actions-nav.test.ts`: restated, not loosened. Its retirement control used Setup's `nav_packages` as proof the walk reads the real array; it now uses `nav_packaged_actions`, which the same file already requires to exist. Its comment and one test title no longer say "beside Packages".
- New pin `setup-packages-door.test.ts`: Setup's shell plus `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` carry no `developer:packages` entry without a `source` filter (and no `nav_packages` id), and Studio's Overview still carries exactly one unfiltered `developer:packages` entry. The predicate has its own positive and negative controls.
- Changeset: `patch` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

## Why

Maintainer ruling 甲 on #25098 (amends #23892 ruling B, item 1): the full package list is a development surface, so its unfiltered entry lives in Studio only, and Setup keeps the marketplace-filtered Installed Apps door. The blocker objectstack-ai/cloud#3138 is cleared: cloud PR #3488 registers that door in hosted tenant environments, so a hosted Setup keeps a way to installed packages.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` (under the verify lock, after building the dependency closure): Test Files 110 passed (110), Tests 1510 passed (1510).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.
- Ablation, one leg plus restore, at commit `510f2898` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: re-inserting Setup's `nav_packages` line into `setup-nav.contributions.ts` turns `Setup ships no unfiltered developer:packages entry` red (`expected [ { id: 'nav_packages', …(4) } ] to deeply equal []`; 1 failed, 2 passed). Restore blob equals the HEAD blob (`e8992d3f9d5b`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the source file directly, so no `dist/` rebuild sits in the path.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` names `nav_packages` only in two comments that record #5750's history (the id was untranslated at the time; the Studio copy did not answer for Setup). Both stay true as history, so they are unchanged. The gate judges the merged Setup app, which no longer carries the id, so it has one id fewer to check.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-installed-ui-entry.pin.test.ts` describes `developer:packages` as "the component Setup's own Packages entry opens" in a doc comment. That clause is now stale; it is outside this card's file surface and left for the seat.
- Setup's `group_apps` translations still list `nav_cloud_connection`; its move to Integrations belongs to #25097, not this card.

## Verification

All readings at head `510f2898`.

<details><summary>Derived gates: 59 derived, 57 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED; plus pnpm lint and check:app-nav-i18n</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 59 commands from the 11 changed paths (merge base `399df5bb`).
- 57 exit 0. `pnpm check:i18n` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (prerequisite not built); after `turbo run build` of the closure the i18n gate names, plus `@objectstack/objectql`, both exit 0: `check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite not met (exit 3). `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full `pnpm build` of about 83 packages; CI's Build Core runs it. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` is checker-health only and needs an unshallow clone.
- `pnpm check:app-nav-i18n` (outside the derivation, run because the card names it): `OK (13 contributor(s), 4 locale(s), 2 app(s) — setup: 56 merged nav id(s), account: 12 merged nav id(s) — every id labelled in every locale)`.
- `pnpm lint` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 57 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
